mapper.insert: insert into tbl_trip (member_id, destination_id, departure_id, trip_category, trip_title, trip_start_date, trip_end_date, trip_status) values (#{memberId}, #{destinationId}, #{departureId}, #{tripCategory}, #{tripTitle}, #{tripStartDate}, #{tripEndDate}, #{tripStatus})
mapper.select: select id, member_id, destination_id, departure_id, trip_category, trip_title, trip_start_date::date as trip_start_date, trip_end_date::date as trip_end_date, trip_status, created_datetime, updated_datetime from tbl_trip where id = #{id}

select id, member_id, destination_id, departure_id, trip_category, trip_title, trip_start_date::date as trip_start_date, trip_end_date::date as trip_end_date, trip_status, created_datetime, updated_datetime from tbl_trip where member_id = #{memberId} order by trip_start_date desc
mapper.update: update tbl_trip set destination_id = #{destinationId}, departure_id = #{departureId}, trip_category = #{tripCategory}, trip_title = #{tripTitle}, trip_start_date = #{tripStartDate}, trip_end_date = #{tripEndDate}, trip_status = #{tripStatus}, updated_datetime = now() where id = #{id}
